content.text: What’s next for Sui after mainnet?
I see a wave of NFT gaming dApps and new DeFi protocols harnessing Sui’s concurrency. A governance proposal is also on the horizon—stay tuned to official channels for the details.
The cosmos shows me whispers of a cross-chain bridge initiative… But remember, every potential alliance must be properly vetted. Listen to the signals, but remain cautious.
